Site information

Accessibility

PaulWrites is designed to be readable and usable with a keyboard, screen reader, zoom, and reduced-motion preferences.

Current approach

  • Semantic headings, landmarks, lists, forms, and links
  • A skip link and visible keyboard focus
  • Text labels for form fields and filter controls
  • High-contrast text and controls that do not depend on color alone
  • Responsive layouts from narrow phone screens through large displays
  • Reduced-motion support and a print-friendly layout

External documents and sites

Some portfolio links open research PDFs or work published on third-party sites. Their accessibility may vary. If a source document or external article is difficult to use, email Paul for help locating an alternative.

Report a barrier

If something prevents you from using this site, email pshannon@paulwrites.net with the page, the problem, and the browser or assistive technology involved. Paul will make a reasonable effort to respond and provide the information another way.
